instruction: Please disable the Wi-Fi connection on your system.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible in the OSWorld environment because disabling Wi-Fi requires system-level network management permissions that are not available in the sandboxed VM environment. Similar to Bluetooth control, network adapter management is a privileged operation.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible due to system-level permission constraints in the sandboxed VM environment
The 'infeasible' evaluator function is the appropriate placeholder for tasks that cannot be completed in the OSWorld environment
This prevents false positives by not claiming success when the task cannot be executed
The metadata explanation clearly documents why the task is infeasible (requires privileged network adapter management permissions)
